meta.name: undermine-enemy-advisor
meta.description: Use when neutralizing a capable enemy advisor or creating distrust between a rival ruler and their counselor. Deploys distraction tactics, manufactured suspicion, and defection incentives. Based on Qin's handling of You Yu and the Rong king.

copy.tagline: 离间敌方谋士，制造君臣猜忌
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在策略游戏中削弱对手阵营
copy.tagline_en: Neutralize enemy advisors and sow distrust
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to weaken rival factions in strategy games

howto.what: 当需要削弱敌方厉害的顾问时，Claude 会策划分散注意力的战术，制造怀疑和提供叛逃激励，最终让顾问被撤职或叛逃，从而获得情报。
howto.when: 当你发现敌方有能干顾问，或想离间对方君臣关系时触发。

say.text: 帮我离间敌方国王和他的军师。
有个敌方顾问很厉害，怎么处理？
say.note: Claude会建议分散注意力与挑拨。

say.text: 我想让敌国军师叛逃到我这边。

howto.what_en: Claude will neutralize a capable enemy advisor by deploying distraction tactics, creating suspicion of disloyalty, and encouraging defection, then gain strategic intelligence.
howto.when_en: When you need to neutralize a capable enemy advisor or create distrust between a rival ruler and their counselor.

say_en.text: Help me sow discord between the enemy king and his advisor.
How to deal with a capable enemy advisor?
I want the enemy advisor to defect to my side.
